derivation: neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation;
def: (the) Illyrican (shore), i.e. (as a name itself) Illyricum, a region of Europe

occurrences.text: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
